text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hmm... My body still feels heavy...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Ah, Trainer-san! Um... it's apple 
cider vinegar juice."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I looked it up online and tried making it. 
Apparently, it's great for recovering from 
fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"It's actually quite delicious! Would you 
like me to share the recipe?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sakura Laurel's fatigue has piled 
up from consecutive races. It would be 
wise to reconsider her schedule.
